title: Yes or No? Animal Quiz for Kids with Milo
description:
Yes or no? Play the animal quiz with Milo the bluebird! Is a polar bear's skin white? Can a polar bear swim? Can a horse sleep standing up? Does a giraffe have the same number of neck bones as you? Pick your answer, then see the proof and count along.
An interactive yes-or-no animal quiz for kids ages 2-6, with thinking time, counting, actions to copy, quick checks and a recap at the end.
tags: yes or no quiz for kids
facts: A polar bear's skin is black (Polar Bears International); its hair is made of clear, hollow tubes, and its fat can be 2 to 4 inches thick (San Diego Zoo, 'Polar bear').

Polar bears paddle with their broad front feet and can swim more than 60 miles without rest (San Diego Zoo, 'Polar bear'); their back legs steer like rudders; the paws are as big as dinner plates (Polar Bears International).
Horses can doze standing up because a 'stay apparatus' locks their legs; they lie down for deep (REM) sleep (PetMD; Merck Veterinary Manual).
A healthy foal stands within one hour of birth and nurses within two (Cornell University College of Veterinary Medicine).
A giraffe has seven neck vertebrae, the same number as a human and almost every other mammal; each can be about 10 inches (25 cm) long (Bristol Zoo; San Diego Zoo).
A giraffe's tongue can be up to 21 inches long (National Geographic Kids, 'Giraffe').

segments.name: hello
lines: Hello, friends! I am Milo the bluebird.
Today we are playing Yes or No!
I will ask a question about an animal friend.
If you think yes, give a thumbs up. If you think no, shake your head.

lines.t: Let's practice. Yes or no. Am I a bluebird?

lines: Yes! I am Milo the bluebird! Good job.
Are you ready? Let's play!

segments.name: polar_bear
lines: Here is the polar bear. Look at that white, fluffy fur.

lines.t: Yes or no. Is a polar bear's skin white?

lines: No! Here is the fun fact. Under the fur, a polar bear's skin is black!
Look closer. Black skin, hiding under all that fur.
exhibit
And the fur is not really white. Each hair is clear, like glass!
exhibit
Under the skin, there is a thick layer of fat. It keeps the polar bear warm in the icy cold.

lines.t: Next question. Yes or no. Can a polar bear swim?

lines: Yes! Polar bears are super swimmers!
Look at those big front paws. They work like paddles in the water.
exhibit
Each paw is as big as a dinner plate!
exhibit
A polar bear can swim a very, very long way, without stopping to rest!
Its back legs steer, like the rudder of a boat.
Brrr! The water is icy cold. But the polar bear stays warm.
Say it with me. Polar bear skin is black!
close:host
Can you paddle your paws like a polar bear? Paddle, paddle, paddle!

lines.t: Quick check! What color is a polar bear's skin? White? Or black?

lines: Black! Black skin, under clear fur. Brilliant!
Clap your paws!

short.title: Polar Bear Skin Is Black! Yes or No Animal Quiz

segments.name: horse
lines: Here is the horse. Clip, clop!

lines.t: Yes or no. Can a horse sleep standing up?

lines: Yes! Here is the fun fact. A horse can sleep standing up!

lines.t: But how can it sleep without falling over?

lines: Its legs lock in place, so it does not fall over.
exhibit
You have two legs. A horse has four! One, two, three, four.
For a big, deep sleep, the horse lies down on the soft ground.
close:horse
A horse does not sleep all night like you. It takes lots of tiny naps!
Now look, a baby horse! A baby horse is called a foal.
teach
A foal can stand up on its wobbly legs when it is only one hour old!
The mama horse feeds her foal with her milk.

lines.t: Now you. Do you sleep standing up? Yes, or no?

lines: No! You sleep lying down, in your cozy bed. But a horse can do both!
Say it with me. Horses can sleep standing up!
close:host
Can you stand very still and close your eyes? Shh. One, two, three.

lines.t: Quick check! For a big, deep sleep, does a horse stand up? Or lie down?

lines: It lies down! Good remembering!
Now wiggle and wake up. Good morning!

short.title: Horses Can Sleep Standing Up! Yes or No Quiz

segments.name: giraffe
lines: Here is the giraffe. Look at that long, long neck!

lines.t: Yes or no. Does a giraffe have the same number of neck bones as you?

lines: Yes! Here is the fun fact. A giraffe has seven neck bones. And so do you!
The giraffe's neck bones are just much, much bigger. Each one is almost as long as a ruler!
exhibit
Let's count them. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven!
exhibit

lines.t: Next question. Yes or no. Does a tiny mouse have seven neck bones too?

lines: Yes! A mouse has seven. You have seven. And the giraffe has seven!
Almost every furry animal has seven neck bones. Big or small!
Let's count on your fingers. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven!
And the giraffe's tongue is long too. Even longer than a ruler!
close:giraffe
It uses that long tongue to grab leaves from the tall, tall trees.
Say it with me. Seven neck bones, just like me!
close:host
Can you touch your neck? Gently now. Nod your head. Yes, yes, yes!

lines.t: Quick check! How many neck bones does a giraffe have? Five? Or seven?

lines: Seven! Just like you!
Hold up seven fingers. Hooray!

short.title: A Giraffe Has 7 Neck Bones, Just Like You!

segments.name: quiz
lines: Wow! What a great game. Let's play one more time, super fast!
Get ready!
quiz: Is a polar bear's skin white?
Can a horse sleep standing up?
Does a giraffe have seven neck bones, like you?

segments.name: goodbye
lines: You learned so many new things today.
Paddle like a polar bear. Stand still like a horse. And nod like a giraffe!
Which answer surprised you the most?

lines.t: One last question. Yes or no. Did you have fun today?

lines: Yes! Me too!
Thank you for playing with me. Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
